name: Dashicons
about: Dashicons is a free, open-source icon set with 347 icons designed by WordPress. From navigation and actions to files, media and communication, it covers everyday UI needs. Every icon is available as SVG, PNG and WebP, or as a copy-paste React / TypeScript component or CDN link. Recolor and resize each one in the browser before you export – free, no account needed. Licensed under GPL.

faqs.a: Yes. All 347 Dashicons are open source under the GPL license – free to download, customize and use. Always check the GPL terms for attribution or commercial-use requirements.

faqs.q: How do I use Dashicons in React or my website?
faqs.a: Copy any icon as a React / TypeScript component straight into your project, or paste the CDN link into your HTML. Every icon also downloads as SVG, PNG or WebP, and you can recolor and resize it in the browser before you export.
There are 347 icons in the Dashicons set, designed by WordPress. Use the search above to find any icon by name.

faqs.q: Can I change the color and size of Dashicons?
faqs.a: Yes. Open any icon, pick a size and color, and the preview updates instantly. SVG, PNG and WebP exports follow your choices, and React snippets recolor through props.

faqs.q: What formats are Dashicons available in?
faqs.a: SVG, PNG and WebP downloads, copy-paste React / TypeScript components, plus a CDN link for every single icon – free, no account needed.
